card.name: The word a before dose-dependent
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "in" when the next words are "dose-dependent fashion", as in opioid warnings about sleep apnea risk. It also fires weakly on "dose" just before "-dependent".

modes.label: "a" before dose-dependent
modes.description: The article "a" in "increases the risk of CSA in a" where "dose-dependent fashion" follows.
modes.example: Opioid use increases the risk of CSA in<< a>> dose-dependent fashion.

modes.label: "dose" before -dependent
modes.description: The word "dose" itself, just ahead of "-dependent" in the same sentence.

card.plain: It spots the spot where the phrase "dose-dependent fashion" is about to come up in a warning about opioids.
